preview.tournamentOverview: Black Desert Resort Golf Course hosts the Bank of Utah Championship with a layout that heavily favors off-the-tee play. The course weights place 33% emphasis on strokes gained off-the-tee and 3% on total strokes gained, making driving distance and accuracy the primary differentiators. This event carries Korn Ferry Tour points and offers a direct path to PGA Tour status for top finishers.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model assigns 33% weight to SG:OTT and 6% to SG:APP, reflecting the course's demand for both distance off the tee and precise approach play. SG:Total receives 3% weight as the overarching performance metric, while SG:ATG and SG:PUTT carry 7% and 4% respectively due to the course's moderate emphasis on short game and putting. Driving accuracy at 6% and bogey avoidance at 3% round out the model, prioritizing players who minimize mistakes on a demanding layout.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournament-specific rankings with power rankings, prioritizing those who excel in the heavily weighted SG:OTT and SG:APP categories. Top selections must demonstrate strong off-the-tee metrics while maintaining solid approach play, with secondary consideration given to SG:Total for overall consistency. Players weak in driving accuracy or prone to bogeys are deprioritized regardless of other strengths.
